basic_info.description: Gorgeous Marina-style home nestled on a tree-lined street in the heart of Excelsior. Lovingly owned and cared for by the same family for nearly 60 years, it offers a perfect blend of classic charm and modern updates. Step inside to discover beautiful hardwood floors, a spacious layout with tall ceilings, and large windows that flood the home with natural light. The expansive living room features a cozy fireplace and built-ins, perfect for relaxation and entertaining. Enjoy formal meals in the elegant dining room, or casual mornings in the light-filled kitchen with a big window and breakfast area.     The home boasts 2 generous bedrooms, an office, and an updated bathroom. The full basement provides a half bath, parking for 3 cars and abundant storage space, with potential for expansion. Step outside to the tranquil backyard garden, complete with fig and other fruit trees-a peaceful retreat. A commuter's dream, this home offers quick access to public transit, BART, and freeways. McLaren Park is just a short walk away, offering jogging trails, dog parks, and playgrounds, perfect for outdoor enthusiasts. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a beautifully maintained and updated home in an ideal location!
